name: facebookresearch_code-prediction-transformer/code2seq/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.build_code2seq_model: build a Code2SeqModel instance with token and subtoken vocab sizes and a loss function
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the Code2SeqModel with starts, paths, ends, and targets tensors
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.embed_code_paths: embed code paths using the node embedding and bidirectional LSTM in Code2SeqModel
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.compute_attention_weights: compute softmax attention weights over embedded tensors using EmbeddingAttentionLayer
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.reset_model_parameters: reset all multi-dimensional parameters in the Code2SeqModel using Xavier uniform initialization

facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.create_dataset_from_jsonl: create a PyTorch Dataset that loads data points from a JSON-lines file with efficient seek-based access
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.get_dataset_length: get the total number of data points in the code2seq Dataset by calling len on it
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.retrieve_data_point_by_index: retrieve a single data point from the Dataset by index using seek-based file reading
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.collate_batch_into_tensors: collate a batch of target, starts, paths, and ends into padded PyTorch tensors for model input
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.pad_sequences_with_combine: pad variable-length start, path, and end sequences to uniform dimensions using the collate combine helper

facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.generate_data_points_from_ast: run generate_data.py to extract terminal-to-terminal paths from AST files and write datapoints to output
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.extract_paths_from_ast: extract all valid paths between terminal nodes in an AST using DFS with a max path length constraint
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.get_leaf_nodes_by_type: get leaf node indices from an AST filtered by id type such as attr, num, name, or param
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.get_all_paths_with_sampling: get all paths for target nodes in an AST with random sampling capped at a max number of paths
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.load_word_to_index_vocab: load a pickled vocabulary file and return a word-to-index mapping with an unknown token fallback

facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.run_generate_vocab_cli: run the generate_vocab script to create a code2seq vocabulary pickle file from a JSON-lines input
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.create_token_vocab: create a token-type vocabulary from a JSON-lines code dataset using the code2seq generate_vocab tool
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.create_subtoken_vocab: create a subtoken-type vocabulary by tokenizing terminal nodes from a JSON-lines code dataset
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.create_output_vocab: create an output-type vocabulary from terminal nodes of a JSON-lines code dataset
facebookresearch_code-prediction-transfo.review_get_value: review the get_value function to understand how it extracts tokens, subtokens, or output nodes from parsed JSON lines
